audience: ecommerce stores that run email and SMS marketing in Omnisend

useCases.title: Check which automations are enabled
useCases.text: List the automation workflows, filtered by enabled state. Open one to read its trigger and blocks.

useCases.title: Size a segment before a campaign
useCases.text: List the contact segments, then read the contact count of one. The count is not ready while a segment is still building.

useCases.title: Look up a contact by email
useCases.text: List contacts filtered by email, then open one to read its tags, status, segments and consent.

useCases.title: Tag the contacts of a segment
useCases.text: Find the segment id, then add a tag to every contact in it. Re-adding a tag changes nothing new.

useCases.title: Create or update a contact from a signup
useCases.text: Create a contact, or update it when the email or phone exists. The welcome message stays off unless you set its flag.

useCases.title: Review the product catalog
useCases.text: List the catalog products and product categories. Open one product to read its variants and prices.
